pages.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
pages.privacy.content_html:
Using our website involves the collection, processing and storage of personal data.

OrientationTech uses this data only to provide orientation services, manage accounts, answer requests and improve the user experience.

Data collected

Information may include name, email address, phone number, test answers, orientation preferences and messages sent through forms.

Use of data

Data is used to generate analyses, recommendations, orientation reports, educational content and service-related communications.

Retention and security

Data is kept for as long as necessary to operate the service and is protected by appropriate technical and organizational measures.

User rights

You may request access, correction or deletion of your data by contacting us through the contact form or by email.

site.about.title: Who are we?
site.about.subtitle_html: An intelligent platform guiding Moroccan students toward digital careers
site.about.p1: OrientationTech helps students discover their potential, Ikigai, personality and the digital fields that best match their profile. The platform combines artificial intelligence, educational sciences and career guidance psychology to provide clear, progressive and personalized orientation.
site.about.quote: Our goal is to help each student understand who they are, identify their strengths and build a coherent path toward higher education and future careers.
site.services.title: OrientationTech: AI-powered school guidance
site.services.subtitle: We help students connect their answers, skills and ambitions to high-potential digital fields.
site.services.desc: OrientationTech analyzes the academic profile, initial diagnostic, Ikigai, personality, interests and motivations to generate personalized and easy-to-understand recommendations.
site.services.adv1_desc: Understand level, favorite subjects, interests and goals.
site.services.adv2_desc: Identify what the student loves, what they are good at and what can become a profession.
site.services.adv3_desc: Analyze creativity, analytical thinking, communication, autonomy and adaptability.
site.services.adv4_desc: Suggest fields, careers, training paths and a personalized action plan.
site.why.title: Why choose OrientationTech?
site.why.subtitle: A student-centered approach adapted to the Moroccan context and supported by artificial intelligence.
site.why.c1_desc: The analysis goes beyond grades and includes interests, motivations, values and personality.
site.why.c2_desc: Each digital field is explained with a compatibility score and clear reasoning.
site.why.c3_desc: The platform suggests Moroccan and international paths based on the student profile and project.
site.why.c4_desc: Students, parents and teachers receive a readable, motivating and exportable report.
site.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
site.faq.subtitle: Understand how OrientationTech supports guidance toward digital careers.
site.faq.q1: Does OrientationTech replace a career counselor?
site.faq.a1: No. OrientationTech is a decision-support tool. It provides clear and personalized analysis to enrich the support provided to students, parents and teachers.
site.faq.a2: The platform combines the academic profile, initial diagnostic, Ikigai, personality test, skills, interests and career ambitions.
site.faq.q3: Are recommendations limited to web development?
site.faq.a3: No. Recommendations cover many fields: artificial intelligence, data science, cybersecurity, cloud, networks, UX/UI, robotics, IoT, EdTech, FinTech and other digital careers.
site.faq.q4: Is the report understandable for parents?
site.faq.a4: Yes. The report explains strengths, improvement areas, compatible fields, possible careers and training paths in simple educational language.
site.faq.a5: Yes. The complete orientation report can be exported as a PDF with results, recommendations and a personalized action plan.
